session resume.notes: Terminal launches run without echoing internal shell commands or exit instructions; agent output and diagnostics remain visible. Saved Codex resume resolves unindexed held sibling locks through validated session_meta workspace identity in active and archived rollouts. A still-unassociated exact lock is inspected through bounded lock-holder open rollout metadata; process cwd and other thread IDs never establish unrelatedness. Unknown, invalid or unreadable evidence fails closed; ownership refusals identify the conversation and verified PIDs with finish/exit recovery and a concise retry diagnostic, without process arguments or a traceback. Confirmed missing/invalid GitHub authentication warns once per affected host before selection, including empty and automatic results, without blocking available conversations; persistent compact picker warning survives filter/sort/reset/all. Remedy: gh auth login --hostname github.com on the named host. Network/rate-limit/permission failures and missing gh do not trigger auth warnings. Cross-host policy: Claude defaults to t transfer; Codex defaults to manual native desktop Hand off (no supported CLI adapter). Agent settings show/persist the effective mechanism and explicit Codex t override. Native returns nonzero with app steps before transfer mutations; local resume and remote attach unchanged. Batch failures stop on the first error or cancellation, print a final identity/reason/retry/ready/not-attempted summary, and never attach over failures. Tab failures retain successful sessions and exit nonzero.

Disabled shows the Review stage as Skipped before PR while retaining its configured model and selection. PR opening, state and merging are independent; When to open PR is Automatically when ready or Only when I ask, and automatic merging is Automerge. Local preview has a Global section with Preview timing above Frontend and CLI submenus, both visible with Enabled/Disabled state. Frontend alone contains Implement before approval (Yes/No/Not set), Design approach, Preview method (Fast reload/Build) and Open in browser (Automatically/Only when I ask). CLI contains Preview method (Install locally/Run from the repo) and Run command (Automatically/Only when I ask); no CLI implementation-approval row or guidance. Disabled summaries suppress retained settings. Tests contains Run tests and Test runners. Lists and catalogue use the same hierarchy and effective choices; save review shows only changed fields. Not set applies to optional choices; Inherit is used only for real parent values. Show effective Implementation or session-default model and selected workers; unselected stages use the main session model/effort, and no selected stages means one model. Never present inactive saved values as effective. Task-selected Implementation uses a bounded worker; show main fixed launch settings separately and label Worker/Main session/Main model sources. Effort pickers separate Automatic from Fixed effort. Per-tool permissions apply to subsequent CLI launch/resume. Retain legacy rules separately. --all is a compact named catalogue. Raw JSON preserves saved keys and text bytes. No picker, write, update prompt, connection or retry. Wide labels use available terminal width; narrow screens retain stacked values. --tool codex|claude|cursor selects the tool catalogue. Omission uses the explicit repository tool override or account default. Reads identify the tool; writes preserve other catalogues. No checkout inference. The parent Local preview settings are labeled Global, not Defaults. Use concise submenu summaries and open Frontend/CLI to inspect details; inherited timing explicitly says Inherit global. Optional stages_enabled defaults true; model_stages is a nonempty unique subset of planning/implementation/review. Legacy separate_stages selects planning/review helpers with Implementation active. Deselecting all stages retains models and selections. Disabled/excluded workflows suppress generated stages, behaviors and Markdown. Optional session_defaults stores codex/claude model and explicit effort, active with Implementation unchecked or stages disabled; omitted values use native defaults. Never rewrite global native settings or active turns. Optional permissions maps codex to ask/auto/full/read_only and claude to manual/acceptEdits/auto/bypassPermissions/plan; explicit invocation permission flags suppress the preset. Stage effort accepts auto or supported explicit levels. Legacy one-level-lower for Implementation/Review resolves auto without read writes. Auto Implementation delegates a concrete-effort worker; the main launch effort stays fixed. Behavior keys include pr_review, pr_open, pr_state, pr_merge, frontend_enabled, cli_enabled, local_preview, frontend_preview_timing, cli_preview_timing, frontend_implement_before_approval, cli_preview, cli_launch, frontend_design, frontend_preview, frontend_browser and test_timing. pr_review retains review/skip storage with Enabled/Disabled labels; omission means Enabled without materializing storage. Disabled skips both main-session and worker pre-PR review, retaining reviewer settings; explicit repository/task requirements still apply. When stages are off, enabled PR review uses the main agent. PR timing/state/merge and validation/preview preferences remain independent. Both preview types inherit local_preview timing unless their timing override is present. Clearing an override restores live inheritance. frontend_implement_before_approval is direct yes/no; no CLI approval gate. Legacy implement_before_approval falls back to the frontend key; explicit frontend wins. Older preview_approval/design_approval map inversely to frontend only. Retired cli_implement_before_approval remains accepted raw but is inert. Clearing frontend approval must not restore aliases. frontend_enabled/cli_enabled independently override legacy preview_target; missing settings enable both types. Disabled types retain stored preferences but suppress runtime instructions. frontend_browser and cli_launch accept automatic/on_request and act only once the corresponding preview is due/requested and ready; neither independently requests a preview. CLI launch composes with install/repo method; request-only launch prepares the command without running it. Interactive CLI launch uses a supported terminal or reports the limitation and exact command. Legacy worktree/preview/validation/delivery values remain readable; explicit choices take precedence. No read-time migration. Unknown keys/values rejected; required repository checks and approvals remain authoritative. The checklist one-model reset maps to stages_enabled=false while retaining configured model_stages and model/effort values. --tool codex|claude|cursor selects the tool catalogue. Omission uses the explicit repository tool override or account default. Reads identify the tool; writes preserve other catalogues. No checkout inference.

workflow.scope: global workflow catalogue and explicit repository assignments
workflow.notes: Bare t workflow opens the shared RailUI staged editor in a terminal; outside a terminal or with --help it prints help without writes. Hidden config workflows alias uses the same editor. Select named workflows and explicit repository assignments, edit Planning/Implementation/Review model-stage checkboxes and selected models/efforts or session defaults, permissions, behaviors and text. Clear text instructions and empty editor contents stage removal; discard publishes nothing. Repository customization is labeled Customize a copy for this repo because it copies the whole policy without later named-policy inheritance. Agent review before PR in Pull requests is an Enabled/Disabled toggle, no Not set row. Missing pr_review shows Enabled; selecting its current value is a no-op. Disabled suppresses agent review and marks Review Skipped before PR while keeping its model controls editable. Local preview exposes Global Preview timing above Frontend and CLI. Frontend and CLI each have independent Preview Enabled/Disabled plus source-aware Inherit global/Override timing. Frontend has a direct Implement before approval Yes/No/Not set choice, Design approach, Fast reload/Build and browser opening. CLI has install/repo method and Run command Automatically/Only when I ask; it has no implementation-approval control. Disabled submenus stay editable and retain settings. Shared pickers separate a leading unset/inherit choice with a blank nonselectable rail row; binary toggles have no unset choice. Tests embeds Test runners beside Run tests. Nested runner edits preserve prior/later behavior edits in the same transaction. Back restores focus and pending choices. No explanatory preambles. Ctrl+C with pending changes offers Keep editing (default), Review and save, or Discard changes and exit from hubs, nested menus and save review. Preserve completed nested edits. Review and save uses the normal final review; repeated interruption never implicitly saves/discards. No edits exits immediately with status 130. Restore terminal state; external editors and post-save actions retain their own behavior. Use multiple models starts with Use one model for all work as an exclusive empty-key reset in the shared checklist, separated from stage choices. Space selects it and clears Planning/Implementation/Review; selecting any stage clears it and clearing the last stage restores it. Enter applies the marks; translate the reset to no active stages. One-model mode exposes session model/effort controls while retaining all saved stage values and other preferences. Cancel and unchanged selections create no repository override or write. Hub and catalogue assignment labels show Global default, Assigned to N repos or Not assigned, with Disabled appended for a disabled definition. Count only explicit non-excluded named assignments, not inline copies or implicit global inheritance. Default-model choices show Inherit with the top-level tool model. Unset effort inherits top-level effort only with an inherited model; an explicit workflow model uses Default for this model. Save review compares against the transaction baseline and displays only changed fields, text lines, runner fields and assignments with before/after values. Preserve visibility of additions, removals, default changes, exclusions and initial activation; omit unchanged workflows and instruction text. Start with Codex/Claude/Cursor, then that tool catalogue. Each tool has independent named definitions, default and repository assignments. Navigation never changes launch tool preferences. Scoped editors merge into one staged document and immutable baseline, including Ctrl+C and runner edits; review shows only changed tool scopes. Models come from the selected CLI. Cursor model IDs contain parameters; no separate effort or permission picker. Unavailable discovery retains Inherit and custom IDs. Existing root data remains Codex; optional tools.claude and tools.cursor store complete catalogues. Shared legacy Claude preferences migrate in memory and freeze on save, with Codex stages removed and explicit Claude defaults/permissions plus delivery/text/runners retained. Reads never write. Native rendering and launch/resume resolve tool before repository scope. Save changes appears once as the persistent footer action with the s shortcut, never as a duplicate menu row. The shortcut opens the existing final diff review. Tool Back navigation restores focus; reverting a newly materialized tool scope restores its absent baseline without discarding other tools edits. The parent Local preview settings are labeled Global, not Defaults. Use concise submenu summaries and open Frontend/CLI to inspect details; inherited timing explicitly says Inherit global. Agent review before PR names the reviewing actor; it remains an Enabled/Disabled toggle.

state.meaning: Reported ownership state; saved history never implies a live owner.

context.meaning: Active-context evidence from the exact current owner; unknown historical context never adds an active mark.

interface.meaning: CLI, desktop, or foreground interface recorded or reported for this conversation.

agent.meaning: The conversation agent, independently of its interface and recorded model.

model.meaning: Exact recorded or current-owner model; never infer a model from the agent name.

host.meaning: Host associated with the displayed conversation or exact current owner.

slot.meaning: Repository and slot/session label, distinct from the immutable conversation ID.

summary.meaning: Working-on text from current-owner evidence, recorded summary, or retained title.

status.meaning: Human-readable ownership/history state label for full details. STATUS marks are rendered separately from state, context, and summary.

prs.meaning: Evidence-backed associated PRs and cached states, independent of incidental mentions.

updated.meaning: Retained activity timestamp; Date remains fully available in the labeled preview and JSON.

associations.meaning: All recorded workspace, slot, host, branch, commit, evidence, and availability snapshots.

sid.meaning: Full immutable conversation ID in details and JSON; SESSION remains the repository/slot label.

mentions.meaning: Incidental links, separately labeled from associated PR evidence.

sources.meaning: Every retained transcript source and its availability.

version.notes: Preserve the release/revision first line; label the actual executable Source and current Git Worktree with absolute paths and branches, even when they differ. Packaged sources say release; detached checkouts say detached HEAD; outside Git is explicit. Escape control characters. Resolve metadata only on request, with no configuration load, network, picker, or update prompt.

first_run.notes: Resolve native agent executables outside PATH for reviewed login steps; failed steps remain resumable. Choice q/Esc navigates back with current selections retained; review n/Esc returns to the last applicable choice. Review q, welcome q/Esc, and Ctrl-C cancel. Empty steps are skipped; completed GitHub install/login is not repeated. Agent sign-in uses a separate optional checklist with no initial marks; skipping sign-in still allows installation. Only chosen sign-ins run after review. Authenticated agents have compact logged-in labels in agent selection, read-only context beside remaining login choices, and an Already logged in summary in review; they never become selectable login actions. After reviewed registration is saved, offer Verify SSH now or Later for distinct added or changed target strings. Native OpenSSH owns the restored terminal and asks for host fingerprint confirmation; never auto-accept trust. Refused/unavailable checks warn and continue, preserving registration. Ctrl-C stops with 130 and retains saved changes; alias/default-only edits never connect.

returning.notes: Choose an existing registered checkout or rerun discovery; reuse session ownership checks.

advisories_opt_in.notes: Only T_VULNERABILITY_CHECK=1: print bounded cached repository-tool findings to stderr and schedule a detached refresh; never block on probes/network or remediate.

bare_t.notes: Interactive startup optionally displays cached repository-tool advisories and schedules detached refresh when T_VULNERABILITY_CHECK=1; nonterminal bare t stays side-effect free.
